_what_this_is: Sources the DMZ fetch worker (scripts/openclaw_axis_worker.py) may reach.
One entry = one URL, one path into its JSON, one axis+key it feeds.
THIS FILE IS THE ALLOWLIST. The worker fetches nothing that is not named
here, so widening what CORTEX reaches from the outside world is a human
edit to a config file, not a decision a model can make at runtime.
_the_contract: Whatever the path resolves to must be a finite number. A string, a null, a
list, a bool — all refused, by name, into external_refusals.jsonl. The
number is what crosses the boundary; nothing else does.
_path_syntax: Dotted keys walk objects. Integer segments index lists.
'#len' takes the length of the list at that point.

sources.why: seismometer network — instrument record, no interested party
